newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian port of Paranagua reported the following conditions for shipping sugar. PARANAGUA:
Vessels: Prometheus loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags, Europegasus loading 25,000 tonnes using big bags
Waiting to dock: seven vessels to load using big bags, one to load bulk
Road: 78 trucks carrying sugar arrived on May 20. Total for May so far 1,927 trucks
Loaded (May 20): 6,846 tonnes using big bags. Total for May so far 42,136 tonnes
Waiting to dock: Unisea due to arrive May 21 to load 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar
Stocks: 20,000 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable
